Subject: GPU pool hiring: phased slate + offer timing and compensation alignment

Team —

We have an opportunity to fill four prioritized slots that unblock GPU pool throughput and kernel reliability: 1) Kernel SRE (senior), 2) Runtime Infra Engineer (mid-senior), 3) KV cache engineer, 4) GPU orchestration engineer. Budget for Q3 is constrained; finance can cover two hires now and two next quarter if we phase them.

Requesting a quick decision on a phased plan so Talent can extend offers this week for the top two roles. Proposed approach (attached workbook):
- Tranche A (immediate): Kernel SRE (senior), Runtime Infra Engineer (mid-senior)
- Tranche B (Q4): KV cache engineer, GPU orchestration engineer

Key asks:
1) Approval to split the slate into two tranches.
2) Confirmation of comp bands and any sign-on authority beyond standard templates (we might need one-time sign-on for the Kernel SRE).
3) Final review of attached job reqs / offer template.

I’ve attached Q3_gpu_budget.xlsx and the job req for kernel SRE. If we get a greenlight by end of day tomorrow, Talent can issue offers to the two candidates we’ve prioritized.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Platform & Runtime
Redwood Inference

Marcus —

Thanks for the plan and the attachments. I’m supportive of phasing the slate (Tranche A now, Tranche B next quarter) provided we align on two items:

1) Comp bands: confirm the kernel SRE is within the senior band 3 range published for runtime roles — if Talent needs to push cash beyond the band we need an exception and justification.
2) Sign-on: I can approve a one-time retention/sign-on up to $20k for senior hires if you make the case why the market requires it. Anything above that goes to compensation committee.

Please send a short justification (2–3 bullets) for a sign-on if you recommend one, and confirm the job levels for the two immediate hires. Lauren — loop in Finance if phasing impacts the Q3 FTE ledger.

-Kimberly

Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-31T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU pool hiring: phased slate + offer timing and compensation alignment

Quick technical note to support Marcus’ ask:

- Kernel SRE (Sr): critical for reducing tail latency when we roll the new kernel set; primary impact on p99 and cache eviction debugging. Market comp for similar roles is ~L5-L6 at FAANG-equivalent bands — recommended band = Senior (band 3).
- Runtime Infra (Mid-senior): immediate throughput wins with minimal onboarding; recommended band = Band 2.
- KV cache and GPU orchestration can be queued to Tranche B; low risk to latency SLAs if we prioritize Kernel SRE first.

Justification for a modest sign-on for Kernel SRE (if needed):
1) Specialized kernel debugging and SIMD/FPGA-like profiling skills are in short supply.
2) We have two external competitors offering counter-offers; 20–30% uplift would be market-competitive.

I’ve updated the attached reqs with the proposed bands and marked the two hires we should extend offers to this week.

-Karthik
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

(attachment: kernel-sre-job-req.docx)
